comment: The length knob is -6 to 0 and is raised as a power of ten to give metres (Sjoegele.cpp:63-68), so the panel's 1µm, 1mm and 1m marks are the ends and the middle of its travel. Gravity is 9.8 times two to the power of the knob, -6 to 6, so the centre is Earth. Friction is ten to the power of eight times the knob, minus one. The two angle outputs are 5V when high, not 10V (lines 111-112), although the maker's manual only says 'high gate'. The panel order of the six outputs is not their index order: the two angle outputs are indexes 4 and 5 and sit at the right of the two rows, after x and y.
